sections.h2: Where is Fort Mill, SC, and what sets it apart from nearby towns?
sections.html:
Fort Mill is a town in York County, South Carolina, and a suburb of Charlotte, North Carolina. It sits at about 646 feet of elevation, and Interstate 77 runs through its western side. Exit 85 is signed for SC Highway 160, which is the main east to west street through town.

The growth is the first thing to understand. The town counted 10,811 residents in 2010 and 24,521 in 2020. It annexed enough land in 2008 to double its physical size, and it now covers about 20 square miles.

sections.h2: Is every Fort Mill address inside the town of Fort Mill?
sections.html:
No. Indian Land, which sits in neighboring Lancaster County, shares a Fort Mill mailing address but lies outside the town boundary. Tega Cay is a nearby community that shares the local school district.

This catches sellers more than you would expect. Your mailing address can say Fort Mill while your property taxes go to a different county and your permits go to a different office. Before you read any tax or permit rule on this page, confirm which jurisdiction your parcel is in. The York County Assessor and the Fort Mill town hall can tell you in one phone call.

Catawba Indians lived in the area first, and Scots-Irish settlers arrived in the 1750s and 1760s. The town takes its name from a colonial-era British fort, and it was established in 1873.

Textile mills drove growth in the late nineteenth century. In 1865 the last full Confederate Cabinet meeting was held at the White Homestead here. In the 1970s and 1980s the town was home to Jim Bakker's Heritage USA. Thirteen sites in the area are on the National Register of Historic Places, including the Fort Mill Downtown Historic District, where Main Street retail sits near Confederate Park and Memorial Park.

If your house is in or near the downtown historic district, ask the town's planning staff whether any review applies to exterior work before you promise a buyer a change.

sections.h2: What are the schools and major employers in Fort Mill?
sections.html:
Fort Mill is the main community in York County School District 4. The district says it serves more than 18,000 students in 21 schools, and it names three high schools: Catawba Ridge, Fort Mill and Nation Ford. Its office is at 2233 Deerfield Drive, Fort Mill, SC 29715.

For employers, the town's reference entry names these companies in or near Fort Mill:

  • LPL Financial
  • Continental Tire
  • Schaeffler Group
  • Sunbelt Rentals
  • Red Ventures
  • Daimler Trucks North America

The town is also the home base of the Carolina Crown Drum and Bugle Corps, which won the 2013 DCI World Class championship. Because Fort Mill is a Charlotte suburb, access to I-77 and SC 160 is part of how many buyers judge a house.

sections.h2: What does the weather mean for a Fort Mill house?
sections.html:
Fort Mill has a humid subtropical climate with four seasons. Summer highs average about 90 degrees and winter highs about 50. The record high is 108 degrees (2007) and the record low is minus 5 (1989).

Winter brings occasional sleet and snow that rarely accumulates, so heavy snow load is not a common concern. Hurricane Hugo in 1989 caused major damage in the area, and the entry notes that no tropical system has hit the area directly since. For a seller, the points that matter most are:

  • Roof age and condition after summer storms.
  • Air conditioning age, given the hot summers.
  • Tree limbs over the roof and gutters on older lots.
  • Any past water intrusion, which should go on the disclosure form.

sections.h2: How do York County property taxes work for a Fort Mill house?
sections.html:
York County values and bills the property. The Assessor handles values and the legal residence application, the Auditor handles exemptions and millage rates, and the Tax Collection Office handles billed amounts and due dates.

OfficePhoneHandles
York County Assessor803-684-8526Values, appraisals, 4 percent legal residence application
York County Auditor803-684-8501Exemptions, tax estimates, millage rates
Tax Collection Office803-684-8527Billed amounts, due dates, payment

Real estate is reappraised every five years under state law. Ownership is determined by the records on December 31 of the prior year, so a deed recorded after that date shows the new owner on the next year's bill. According to the county, sellers normally pay their share of taxes at closing, and the buyer may owe the full-year notice, so confirm the split with the closing attorney.

A sale can trigger a fresh valuation. The county says a property with an assessable transfer of interest is reassessed in the tax year after the transfer, and the 15 percent cap on increases from a countywide reassessment does not apply in the year a qualifying transfer first becomes taxable. Moving a home into a trust also removes the 4 percent assessment until the owner reapplies.

The state sets the assessment ratios: 4 percent for a legal residence and 6 percent for other real property. The first penalty date for taxes is January 16. Ask the Tax Collection Office for the penalty schedule and the due date on your bill, because those details are not on the county page we read.

sections.h2: What is the closing process for a Fort Mill sale?
sections.html:
A South Carolina attorney handles the closing, and the deed is recorded with the York County Register of Deeds. The state Supreme Court treats preparing deeds, examining title and supervising a closing as the practice of law, as discussed in Boone v. Quicken Loans (2017).

The state deed recording fee is $1.85 for the first $500 of value plus $1.30 for each further $500, per the Department of Revenue.

Sellers must give the buyer a written property condition disclosure before a contract is signed, unless an exemption applies. The form covers the water supply and sewer, structural and mechanical systems, wood-destroying insects, zoning and land use, leases, and homeowners association governance. In a Fort Mill subdivision, gather your HOA documents and any dues before you list.

sections.h2: What permits and codes should a Fort Mill seller know?
sections.html:
The Town of Fort Mill Building and Codes Department handles permits through an online portal called Evolve. You can submit applications, pay fees, check status and schedule inspections there. The department's phone is 803-547-2034, and Town Hall at 205 N. White Street is open weekdays from 8:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

The town enforces the 2021 International Property Maintenance Code, the 2021 South Carolina residential and building codes, the 2020 National Electrical Code and the 2021 swimming pool and spa code. Inspection requests must be in by 3 p.m. to be completed the next business day.

If a prior owner finished a basement, added a deck or installed a pool, ask the department whether permits were closed. Open permits are easier to fix before a sale than during one. The town's page does not describe rental or short-term rental rules, so ask the town directly if a buyer plans to rent the home.

faqs.q: Which county do I pay property tax to if I live in Fort Mill?
faqs.a: Most Fort Mill town addresses are in York County, which bills and collects the tax. Some addresses with a Fort Mill mailing address, such as Indian Land, are in Lancaster County, so check your parcel before you call an office.

faqs.q: Who do I call about the 4 percent legal residence rate in York County?
faqs.a: The York County Assessor at 803-684-8526. The county says a large jump in an escrow payment can mean the mortgage company estimated taxes at the owner-occupied rate and the owner never applied.

faqs.q: Does selling my Fort Mill house raise the buyer's taxes?
faqs.a: It can. A property with an assessable transfer of interest is reassessed in the tax year after the transfer, and the 15 percent cap on increases does not apply in the year a qualifying transfer first becomes taxable.

faqs.q: Do I need permits to be closed before I sell in Fort Mill?
faqs.a: Open permits are better resolved before closing. Call the Town of Fort Mill Building and Codes Department at 803-547-2034 with your address to ask what is on file.

faqs.q: Can Cash Home Buyers buy a Fort Mill house as is?
faqs.a: We buy houses in any condition, and the closing still runs through a South Carolina attorney and the York County Register of Deeds. Tell us about the property and we will explain what we can do.
